description: Build a season-aware daily devotional for a date: the liturgical season and colour, a KJV passage chosen for that season, three reflection QUESTIONS, and a prompt for the member to pray in their own words. No key required. IMPORTANT, two things this is not. (1) It is NOT the lectionary: the reading is SoapBox's own seasonal selection, not the appointed Revised Common Lectionary reading, whose compiled tables are licensed and are not reproduced. Do not tell a member this is 'today's appointed reading'. (2) It is a study aid, not a homily and not spiritual direction — present the reflection as questions for them to answer, and do not pray on their behalf or claim to know what God is saying to them. Point to their pastor for pastoral care. The same date always returns the same reading, so a member can replay it.

date.description: The day to build the devotional for, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).

reference.description: Optional: use this passage instead of the season's selection, e.g. when a member asks for a specific verse.

name: get_daily_devotional
